newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes unchanged in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes unchanged in consolidation.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended flat after trade scale-down buying and speculative selling batted prices on both sides of unchanged throughout the session, dealers said.

March closed at 10.17, after trading from 10.23 to 10.13. The deferred contracts finished 0.03 lower to 0.03 higher. Volume was estimated at 32,273 lots, compared with Tuesday's official volume of 46,994 lots.
Market sources said prices may be poised for a technical bounce as they held above support seen at Tuesday's low of 10.10 cents in March.
But while the market remains oversold from a technical point of view, it is not likely to climb to resistance pegged at a gap on the charts between 10.47 and 10.50.
Instead, the contract is seen slipping to 10.10 in the short term, and then falling below 10.00 cents, traders said.
A lack of substantial offtake will keep prices under pressure, they added.
"Today, there was good buying every point down to the lows in March," a dealer said. "But if we fall below, I'm leery it will trigger major spec selling and the market will plunge below 10.00 cents."
Further, an increase in open interest of 3,850 lots in March amid sharp losses Tuesday may signal imminent speculative selling, analysts said.
